properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 30 at 4:46AM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
At 445 AM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Tooele Army Depot, or 9 miles southwest of Tooele, moving northeast
at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
West Valley City, Tooele, West Jordan, Taylorsville, South Jordan,
Draper, Riverton, Herriman, Bluffdale, Ophir, Kearns, Tooele Army
Depot, Magna, Bingham Canyon Mine, Oquirrh, Camp Williams, Tooele
Army Depot South, Stockton, Rush Valley, and Copperton.

This includes Interstate 15 between mile markers 288 and 290.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.
properties.area: Great Salt Lake Desert and Mountains; Tooele and Rush Valleys; Salt Lake Valley

properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 30 at 5:36AM CDT until August 30 at 6:15AM CDT by NWS Bismarck ND
properties.description:
At 536 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 12 miles northeast
of Watford City, moving east at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Tobacco Garden Bay Recreation Area.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 30 at 5:23AM CDT until August 30 at 8:30AM CDT by NWS Bismarck ND
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...North Central Dunn County in southwestern North Dakota...

* WHEN...Until 830 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 523 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of North Central Dunn County.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 30 at 7:35PM ChST until August 30 at 10:30PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
FFWGUM

The National Weather Service in Tiyan has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern coasts of Guam...

* Until 1030 PM ChST.

* At 735 PM ChST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain across the
warned area. Additional rainfall amounts of 2 to 3 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Merizo, Piti, Santa Rita and Umatac.

Apra Harbor and Naval Base Guam.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 29 at 9:38PM MST until August 30 at 9:30AM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 930 AM MST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry washes. Overflowing poor
drainage areas. Some low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 934 PM MST, gauge reports indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms fell in the middle and upper reaches of the Vamori
Wash this evening. This will cause small stream flooding. Rises
in the Vamori Wash could be sudden, but the flood wave will
slowly travel downstream.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
San Simon Wash, Hali Murk Wash, Chukut Kuk Wash, San Luis Wash
and Vamori Wash.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Santa Cruz and Kupk.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain.
Washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 29 at 5:29PM CDT until August 31 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following river in Illinois...
Indiana...

Wabash River at Hutsonville to Vincennes

.Minor flooding continues on the Wabash River from Hutsonville down
to Vincennes. The river has crested. Flooding should come to an end
on the Wabash over the weekend.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Riverton.

* WHEN...Until Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 18.0 feet, Extensive lowland flooding is in progress.
High water surrounds many river cabins.  Access to most river
cabins is by boat only.  Levees begin to protect farmland.
Extensive flooding of Leaverton Park occurs in Palestine, Illinois.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:00 PM CDT /6:00 PM EDT/ Saturday the stage was 17.6 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 5:00 PM CDT /6:00 PM EDT/ Saturday was 19.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
Monday morning and continue falling to 5.1 feet Tuesday,
September 08.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued Sunday morning at 915 AM CDT /1015
AM EDT/.
properties.area: Crawford, IL; Lawrence, IL; Knox, IN; Sullivan, IN
